recognize_zh: 拼圖中多顆嗜中性球的核葉以放射狀圍繞中心點排列、彼此由細絲相連，形似葡萄串或花朵（botryoid neutrophils）；在古柯鹼使用或熱傷害、中暑等情境中可見。
features: Mature neutrophils of normal size with fine pink-lilac cytoplasmic granules
Nuclear lobes (4-6) arranged radially around a central point, producing a grape-cluster or flower-like configuration
Lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments converging centrally
Condensed mature chromatin; no toxic vacuolation or Döhle bodies evident
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of multiple neutrophils) shows mature neutrophils with normal cytoplasmic granulation whose nuclear lobes are arranged radially around a central point and joined by thin filaments, producing a botryoid (grape-cluster or flower-like) configuration. Chromatin is mature and there is no significant toxic change in these cells. Botryoid nuclei are a nonspecific finding associated with hyperthermia, heat stroke, burns and recreational drug use such as cocaine. Findings are consistent with botryoid neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have 6 or more lobes arranged linearly along a chromatin strand rather than radially around a central hub, with macro-ovalocytes.

ddx.dx: Clover-leaf / flower cells of HTLV-1 adult T-cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Flower cells are lymphocytes with agranular basophilic cytoplasm and petal-like lobulated nuclei, not granulated neutrophils.
Neutrophils show pyknotic, hypercondensed lobes separated by long thin filaments, with profound neutropenia.
